server_timezone.source: XM Help Center confirms GMT+2 winter / GMT+3 summer; EA uses DST_EU (enum 1).
server_timezone.dst_rule: DST_EU, consistent with published server offsets and the existing EA default.
server_timezone.timestamp_handling: The MT5 Python API returned current tick/bar epochs about three hours ahead of the machine UTC clock; recorded raw values are labeled broker-server time. UTC estimates subtract the XM seasonal offset. This interpretation is an inference from the live clock comparison and broker documentation.
